mutation_testing::setup.cfg.head:
[mutmut]
# Mutation test scope — per SAB NFR-08.
# Note: uses mutmut 2.x syntax (not 3.x); pin: pip install "mutmut==2.5.1"
paths_to_mutate=03-development/src/taskq_api/repository,03-development/src/taskq_api/service
paths_to_exclude=__init__.py,config.py
tests_dir=03-development/tests
# Baseline scope, expressed with -k so it is cwd-independent (mutmut runs
# the runner from a temp workdir, where a path-relative --ignore silently
# matches nothing):
#   * `test_ac_n*` — the NFR acceptance tests assert on the *environment*
#     (degradations log, pinned deps, license scan, `make verify-system`).
#     None of them can kill a mutant in repository/ or service/, two of
#     them shell out to a nested pytest that the framework's
#     PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 baseline env breaks, and one of
#     them re-runs the whole suite — which would multiply every mutant's
#     runtime by the suite's.
#   * `test_perf_*` — pytest-benchmark's `benchmark` fixture is not
#     importable under PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD=1 (see
#     harness/core/quality_gate/mutation_enforcer.py:_mutmut_subprocess_env).
# CI itself runs `pytest 03-development/tests` unfiltered (NFR-09 AC-N9.3);

test_coverage::pyproject.toml.head:
[tool.pytest.ini_options]
# NFR-09 AC-N9.3 forbids structural test exclusion (`--ignore` / `-k` /
# `--deselect` / `collect_ignore`), so this block declares no filters.
# The three tests that used to be deselected here now run in-suite:
#   - test_ac_n1_1 / test_ac_n1_2 seed their 10k rows with one bulk
#     `executemany` instead of 10k ORM inserts (seconds -> milliseconds);
#   - test_ac_n12_2 recurses into `make verify-system`, which exports
#     TASKQ_INSIDE_VERIFY_SYSTEM=1 for the suite it chains, so the inner
#     invocation asserts the sentinel rather than re-entering make.
# The pytest-cov timeout for this project is raised to 900s in
# .methodology/harness_config.json to cover the nested run.
